verdict.rationale: Claude's own docs show you can upload data files such as CSV, XLSX and JSON, or connect Google Drive documents. Claude then analyzes and visualizes that data in the product and can produce reports with charts. That directly delivers AI-generated insights from user data. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of data-analysis quality, and explicit documentation of proactive suggestions or recommendations (as opposed to on-request analysis).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Claude can work with the following document types: - PDF - DOCX - CSV - TXT - HTML - ODT - RTF - EPUB - JSON - XLSX
produce reports with charts and visualizations, and generate presentations from your documents—all without specialized software skills
analyzing data using your organization's specific workflows
Claude analyzes both text and visual elements (like images, charts, and graphics) in PDFs of 100 pages or fewer
